svg.title: Jonathan Aaris Henningsen. IT consultant, datacenter and infrastructure, at Perspektiva IT.
svg.text: IT consultant at Perspektiva IT, where I look after the
datacenter and backup — Nutanix hosting, HYCU, Fortinet
networks, and a lot of Linux. I'd rather automate and improve
than just keep the lights on. Evenings belong to a homelab
that's honestly gotten a bit out of hand: Proxmox, TrueNAS,
